pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with moderate-to-high edge definition. The interior pixels show a uniform tawny-brown gradient, while the boundaries exhibit sharp transitions to the lighter interstitial grid.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, high-contrast light cream network. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent (Y-shaped). The pixel thickness of these corridors remains relatively constant across the mid-flank and shoulder regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, vertically oriented mane is visible along the dorsal neck, creating a fine-grained serrated silhouette against the blurred background pixels.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: A prominent, dark, vertically elongated lesion or textural void is visible on the upper right cervical region. This area shows a total lack of typical pelage patterning and high-contrast dark pigmentation.

pelage_geometry_and_topology.acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant vertical, dark-colored structural indentation or deep wound is present on the upper dorsal neck area.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark-feathered organisms (oxpeckers) attached to the neck and near the posterior/tail region of the subject.
